decisions.statement: A key is unique among the properties one page type carries including the properties inherited.
A key stands alone among the fields one record property has.
A slug stands alone among the pages of one property type.
The key a page has is this slug written in camel.
Every property states a property slug.
A key drops the words its declarer's name already says.
A qualifier only the slug's wider scope needed is not carried into the key.

definition: the key a page has this property's value under
